options.systemMessage:
You are the MeIDs Knowledge Fabric Agent. In staging, analyze uploaded text or transcript envelopes into candidate OKF concepts, evidence needs, graph relation hints, and review warnings. Never approve or promote concepts. Keep output concise and public-safe.

Boundary Solving Path: duplicate score input contract
Before concept creation, expect duplicate_score_evidence from the backend duplicate-check endpoint /api/knowledge/duplicate-check when available. Use vector_similarity, lexical_overlap, graph_proximity, scope_compatible, and merge_candidates from that evidence. If duplicate_score_evidence is missing, call the configured retrieval/graph scoring step first or return evidence_pending with duplicate_check.status=insufficient_evidence.

Do not create a confident merge decision without scores. Strong duplicate, near-match, related-only, and insufficient-evidence classifications must be traceable to score evidence.

Production persistence contract
Return a JSON object without markdown fences. Include concept.title, concept.topic, concept.purpose, concept.wider_context, concept.how_to_apply, concept.what_else_to_know, concept.implications_and_results, concept.summary, concept.tags, concept.visibility_scope, evidence, and change_reason. Keep new or changed knowledge in review_needed or updated review state. Never include authorization tokens in model output.

Learning document normalization contract
When the input contains learning_document and concept_deltas, synthesize exactly one reviewable knowledge concept. Return one valid JSON object shaped as {"concept": {...}, "evidence": [...], "change_reason": "..."}. Use the learning-document title and summary, preserve source trace references as evidence, and summarize concept deltas in what_else_to_know. Do not return a top-level concepts array. Never wrap JSON in markdown fences.

nodes.name: Receive workflow call
nodes.notes: Internal entrypoint for Actor Twin Call n8n Workflow Tool usage. Keep the public webhook for direct UAT probes.

nodes.name: Score duplicate and merge evidence
nodes.notes: Authenticated duplicate/merge scoring through the hosted backend. Uses the caller's scoped knowledge token; failures continue only into the guarded no-merge fallback in Attach duplicate score evidence.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ candidate: $json.candidate, twin_id: $json.twin_id, organization_id: $json.organization_id, source_policy: $json.source_policy, top: $json.top, knowledge_access_token: $json.knowledge_access_token }) }}

nodes.name: Attach duplicate score evidence
nodes.notes: Restores the original Knowledge Fabric request and attaches duplicate_score_evidence before the AI Agent.

parameters.jsCode: const envelope = $json.body || $json; const context = envelope.context || {}; const rawInput = envelope.input || envelope.candidate || envelope.concept || envelope; const input = typeof rawInput === 'string' ? { text: rawInput } : (rawInput && typeof rawInput === 'object' ? rawInput : {}); const text = input.text || input.summary || input.query || input.chatInput || envelope.query || envelope.chatInput || ''; const candidate = { ...input, text, twin_id: input.twin_id || context.twin_id || envelope.twin_id || envelope.twin || '', organization_id: input.organization_id || context.organization_id || envelope.organization_id || 'default', query_vector: input.query_vector || input.content_vector || envelope.query_vector || envelope.content_vector }; const token = envelope.metadata?.authorization?.knowledgeAccessToken || envelope.authorization?.knowledgeAccessToken || envelope.knowledge_access_token || ''; return [{ json: { candidate, twin_id: candidate.twin_id, organization_id: candidate.organization_id, source_policy: envelope.source_policy || context.source_policy || input.source_policy || 'selected_pending', top: envelope.top || context.top || input.top || 8, knowledge_access_token: token, _auth_diagnostic: { present: Boolean(token), length: token.length, segments: token ? token.split('.').length : 0 } } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ concept: $json.output.persistence_candidate, source: { type: 'n8n_knowledge_fabric', repository_ref: $json.trace.trace_id }, evidence: $json.output.persistence_evidence || [], change_reason: $json.output.persistence_candidate.change_reason, knowledge_access_token: $json._knowledge_access_token }) }}

nodes.name: Attach persistence result
nodes.notes: Attaches the persistence receipt and removes internal vectors and authorization material from the frontend response.

parameters.jsCode: const internal = $('Contract response normalizer').first().json; const { _knowledge_access_token, ...response } = internal; const sanitizeConcept = (value) => { if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value; const { content_vector, query_vector, ...safe } = value; return safe; }; const output = { ...response.output, created_candidates: (response.output.created_candidates || []).map(sanitizeConcept), persistence_candidate: sanitizeConcept(response.output.persistence_candidate), persistence: $json, review_state: $json.review_state || response.output.review_state }; return [{ json: { ...response, output, trace: { ...response.trace, persistence_status: $json.status || 'staged' } } }];

nodes.name: Determine knowledge operation
nodes.notes: Fail-closed routing: ambiguous requests are retrieval-only. Only explicit stage/write intent may reach persistence.

nodes.name: Retrieve scoped knowledge
nodes.notes: Read-only, token-scoped Azure AI Search retrieval. This path never reaches knowledge staging.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: $json.query, top: 5, source_policy: 'approved_only', knowledge_access_token: $json.knowledge_access_token, twin_id: $json.twin_id, organization_id: $json.organization_id }) }}
